rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for the insect.

example.english: Be careful, there is a bee over there.
example.jyutping: siu2 sam1 di1 go2 dou6 jau5 zek3 mat6 fung1

rows.note: Use this for the Latin-script letter B itself.

example.english: In English, the letter bee is pronounced this way.
example.jyutping: jing1 man4 jap6 min6 bi1 zi6 duk6 ni1 go3 jam1

rows.note: Use this general noun for the contest sense, including a spelling or geography bee.

example.english: There is an English spelling bee tomorrow, so remember to arrive early.
example.traditional: 聽日有個英文串字比賽，記得早啲到。
example.jyutping: ting1 jat6 jau5 go3 jing1 man4 cyun3 zi6 bei2 coi3 gei3 dak1 zou2 di1 dou3

rows.note: Use this for a community gathering where people share physical work.

example.english: Our village is having a community work bee today, and everyone is repairing the road together.
example.traditional: 我哋村今日有集體勞動，大家一齊修路。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 cyun1 gam1 jat6 jau5 zaap6 tai2 lou4 dung6 daai6 gaa1 jat1 cai4 sau1 lou6
